summary: Derive native timeline headers from bounded folded facts and prepare display bodies only for the requested page and its has-more probe, rather than the full 200-entry header window.

replay.detail: Transcript folding and replay are unchanged.

schema.detail: No durable schema or wire shape changes.

rules.detail: No runtime or admission rules change.

compatibility.detail: Normal headers and returned items remain byte-identical. Headers now retain bounded native facts from an oversized head entry even when its display body is replaced with native-entry-too-large, and pending questions use the native call_id even when display payload clipping previously removed it. Header values are independently bounded and control characters are removed.

downtime.detail: No migration or coordinated downtime is required.

manual.detail: For an approved live owner comparison, run python3 scripts/measure-timeline-first-page with explicit --socket, --session and --label before/after. It reports cold and warm first-page timings for limits 1 and 20 and does not restart daemons.

recovery.detail: No persisted state changes; ordinary binary rollback applies.
